patterns.mechanism: The zero-split fast path yields a materialized iterable unconditionally, so an empty input emits one empty group while the normal path emits no groups.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Across the bounded split_before/split_after/split_when family, materialize the iterable once in each zero-split branch and yield it only when the buffer is non-empty.
patterns.mutation_contract: Replace the three sibling unconditional fast-path yields with one materialization and a non-empty guard per function, preserving each immediate return.

patterns.mechanism: The numeric-range regular expression can start inside a longer identifier or dotted version because its closed and right-open branches have no left token-boundary constraint.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Require a non-word, non-dot left boundary before closed and right-open numeric ranges while preserving the separately anchored left-open range branch.
patterns.mutation_contract: Add a left-boundary assertion around only the closed and right-open range alternatives and retain existing left-open range handling.

patterns.mechanism: The help formatter compares an arbitrary default object directly with an empty string, so a user-defined equality method can raise before the value is rendered.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Guard the empty-string comparison with an exact string-type check so non-string defaults proceed to their existing string rendering path.
patterns.mutation_contract: Require the default value to be a string before comparing it with the empty string, while preserving empty-string display and all remaining default formatting branches.

patterns.mechanism: The registry-backed Windows folder resolver assumes the selected shell-folder value exists, so a missing registry value escapes as FileNotFoundError instead of using the existing environment fallback.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Catch only the missing-value boundary around the registry query and delegate that case to the existing environment-variable folder resolver.
patterns.mutation_contract: Add a FileNotFoundError fallback around QueryValueEx while preserving successful registry reads, unknown-name validation, and all unrelated exceptions.

patterns.mechanism: The operating system reports an out-of-range timestamp as OSError, but the OSError branch emits a generic conversion message that violates the cross-platform range-error contract.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Normalize both operating-system range exception variants to the same stable out-of-range ValueError without changing valid timestamp conversion.
patterns.mutation_contract: Handle OverflowError and OSError through one range-error boundary and preserve the existing boolean, negative-value, timezone, and successful conversion behavior.

patterns.mechanism: The import parser recognizes a bare import keyword as a candidate statement and unconditionally reads a second token that is absent.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Reject incomplete import statements before indexing their token list while preserving package extraction for complete import and from forms.
patterns.mutation_contract: Guard the second-token access by token count and return the established no-package result for incomplete input without weakening the existing syntax assertions.

patterns.mechanism: The escaped-line loop assumes every trailing backslash has a following physical line and indexes past the input boundary when the file ends immediately after it.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Bound the escaped-line continuation loop by the known line count before reading the next line, preserving normal multiline import parsing.
patterns.mutation_contract: Add the existing index-versus-line-count guard to the trailing-backslash loop and leave comment, parenthesis, and import categorization behavior unchanged.
